items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: You’d hear Benny Goodman and Woody Herman, Gus Arnheim, Coon Saunders, Lunceford of course, and Basie and Andy Kirk and Ellington.

ctx.x: You’d hear Benny Goodman and Woody Herman, Gus Arnheim, Coon Saunders, Lunceford of course, and Basie and Andy Kirk and Ellington. I remember a great band that I heard, beside Chick Webb, Benny Carter had a band broadcasting from ballrooms here in New York City and had Eddie, what’s his name, “Canadian Sunset” had him on piano in fact.
